summary: Structural wall sections, design criteria, material notes, connections, and special-inspection notes are shown. One apparent sheet-local discrepancy was identified between the stated soil bearing pressures; confirmation against the geotechnical and structural design basis is recommended.

drafts.title: Conflicting soil bearing pressure values
drafts.observation: The Masonry and Foundation Notes state an “ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL” of 1,500 PSF in note 1, while note 8 refers to a “MINIMUM DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF” at the footing depth. The sheet does not explain whether these values represent different conditions or identify which value governs the footing design.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Note 1: “ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL IS 1,500 PSF.” Note 8: “...MINIMUM DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF...”
drafts.drawing_location: Right-side Structural Notes area, Masonry and Foundation Notes, notes 1 and 8.
drafts.recommendation: Reconcile the 1,500 PSF and 2,500 PSF criteria with the geotechnical report and structural calculations. Clarify the applicable soil condition, allowable/design terminology, and governing value on the permit drawings; professional structural/geotechnical verification is needed.
